cause_quote: The pane added `mobileComposer: Boolean(mobileHost)` and `mobileActivities: mobileHost ? this.mobileChatActivities(state, selectedSession, chatProps) : undefined`, enabling floating activity pills beneath the unchanged, fixed-position Scroll to latest button.
user_saw: In mobile chat, Scroll to latest could cover an activity pill, and tapping it with an expanded draft could collapse the composer without scrolling.
summary: The fix raises Scroll to latest when a pill overlaps it and keeps the composer expanded through the tap.
reasoning: The earlier commits added the pill component and composer interaction code, and the #176653 pane diff first enabled both in the live mobile conversation. I checked that the centered button already existed and retained its fixed offset when the pills were enabled, so the overlap shipped with the new mobile layout. The same activation also enabled the outside-pointer handler that collapsed the composer before a tap on the button could register.
